insights.one_liner: ACCA Careers is the London-based careers arm of the accountancy body ACCA, connecting employers with ACCA-qualified talent; it is not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: It connects employers with ACCA accountancy and finance talent and is run as an educational institution.
It is headquartered in London, with about 60 people on LinkedIn, mostly in accounting, admin, sales and HR roles.

open.text: ACCA Careers is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
